<a id="counting-what-stands-and-what-depends--所立者与依存的计数"></a>
# Counting what stands and what depends

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`counting-standing-and-dependence` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](counting-standing-and-dependence.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Under each selection of the premises, what stands obeys the laws of counting what is active; under enclosure, balance and dissipation alone bound the change of what stands, with no embodiment; and the premises add no law to counting dependences.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Read of standing: a census of what stands lists at each step, once each, the relata standing there; its counts are how many stand at each step and how many cease to stand and come to stand across it. (`Becoming.Web.StandingCensus`, `Becoming.World.StandsObey`)
2. Where every relatum is embodied, what stands is what is active: a census of what stands is a census of activity and conversely, with the same counts, so the two obey the same properties. (`Becoming.World.Embodied.standsObey_iff`)
3. Where embodiment is not selected, a queue fed from a source meets every other premise whatever its counts: its driver, a ground relatum, is active throughout and stands at nothing, its members stand while in the queue and are never active; only the source gives and takes, and as it exchanges a unit each way with every ground relatum, no family is closed across any step, so the queue balances and dissipates. (`Becoming.World.sourcedQueue`, `Becoming.World.sourcedQueue_holds`, `Becoming.World.sourcedQueue_meets`)
4. Its census of what stands counts what the queue counts; so under each of the 256 selections the laws of counting what stands are those of counting what is active: the tally and, exactly where the selection binds counting, nothing coming to stand across a step at which nothing stands. (`Becoming.World.sourcedQueue_standing`, `Becoming.World.sourcedQueue_counts`, `Becoming.World.standing_counting_under`, `Becoming.World.standing_iff_counting`, `Becoming.World.standing_binds_iff`)
5. Enclosure bounds what stands with no premise on activity: under a balanced, dissipative flow with every step from T on enclosed, the change from T of any census of what stands stays within the total standing at T (each relatum standing stands at one or more), and nothing comes to stand across an enclosed step at which nothing stands; both are corollaries of the laws of one step. (`Becoming.World.enclosure_bounds_standing`, `Becoming.Web.StandingCensus.length_le_stock`, `Becoming.World.enclosed_binds_standing`)
6. A selection bounds what stands where it selects balance and dissipation. (`Becoming.World.BoundsStanding`)
7. With all steps from some step on enclosed, a property of counts holds of each census of what stands in each such world meeting a selection exactly when it holds of every tally in which, where it binds counting, nothing comes to stand across a step at which nothing stands, and, where it bounds what stands, from some step T on change stays within a bound and nothing comes to stand across a step at which nothing stands. (`Becoming.World.enclosed_standing_counting_under`)
8. There a change bound is a law exactly where balance and dissipation are selected, while for activity embodiment is needed as well. (`Becoming.World.enclosed_standing_bound_iff`, `Becoming.World.enclosed_change_bound_iff`)
9. Where balance is selected without embodiment the witnesses are waiting queues: closing queues whose next to join is active before it comes to stand, so that the front is active at every step, even with the queue empty. (`Becoming.EnclosedQueue.waiting`, `Becoming.World.waitingQueue`, `Becoming.World.waitingQueue_holds`, `Becoming.World.waitingQueue_meets`)
10. Closing at the first step, a waiting queue is enclosed at every step and meets every premise but dissipation and embodiment; closing at T, with a change bound from T and nothing joining an empty queue from then on, it meets every premise but embodiment. (`Becoming.World.closingQueue_dissipative`)
11. Every step of a finite world is enclosed, so under each selection the laws of counting what stands in finite worlds are those of a tally with at most some number standing at each step, with nothing coming to stand across a step at which nothing stands where the selection binds counting or bounds what stands, and a change bound from the first step where it bounds what stands. (`Becoming.World.finite_standing_counting_under`, `Becoming.World.finite_standing_binds_iff`, `Becoming.World.finite_standing_bound_iff`)
12. The finite witness is a ring each of whose places is active throughout and stands while held, meeting every premise but dissipation and embodiment. (`Becoming.World.activeRing`, `Becoming.World.activeRing_holds`)
13. Read of dependence: with requiring decided, the premises add nothing to the law of counting dependences: under each selection, in every world, with every step from some step on enclosed and, with at most some number holding at each step, in finite worlds, a property of the counts of a census of dependences holds exactly when it holds of every tally. (`Becoming.Web.DependenceCensus`, `Becoming.World.DependsObey`, `Becoming.World.dependence_counting`, `Becoming.World.enclosed_dependence_counting`, `Becoming.World.finite_dependence_counting`)
14. In a finite world dependences are pairs of relata, at most the square of their number. (`Becoming.pairs`, `Becoming.mem_pairs`)
15. Members of a queue, or places of a ring, depending on a common condition while in it, each needing a unit of it, which stands at one and is active throughout, every dependence met, with nothing flowing, meet all eight premises whatever the counts. (`Becoming.World.still_premised`, `Becoming.World.dependingQueue_premised`, `Becoming.World.dependingRing_premised`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Listing and decidability: as in whole-law-of-counting; read of standing, a positive level is decided (a comparison of natural numbers), read of dependence, requiring is decided. It is a logical commitment of the representation. A census lists finitely many standing and finitely many dependences at each step.
- Pointwise: as in whole-law-of-counting, in place of function extensionality, a hypothesis of the theorems.
- Enclosure and finiteness: as in counting-under-enclosure, conditions on worlds stated as hypotheses of the theorems, not axioms.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The laws of counting what stands and what depends where each selected premise binds are not stated; for activity, see whole-law-of-counting and counting-under-enclosure.
- Joint laws of the three counts are not stated.
- The witnesses use members standing without acting and a source acting without standing, which the representation allows; no claim is made that such worlds are common.
- **Counterexample:** World.sourcedQueue: without embodiment what stands and what is active part, and a relatum can come to stand from nothing across a step at which nothing stands in a world meeting every other premise; so nothing coming to stand across a step at which nothing stands is a law only where the selection binds counting. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Standing.lean)
- **Counterexample:** World.waitingQueue and World.enclosed_standing_counting_under: with balance and dissipation selected but not embodiment, the change of what stands before enclosure is unconstrained, members joining an empty queue before step T in a waiting queue closing at T; without dissipation a waiting queue closing at the first step counts every tally, and enclosure adds no law of what stands. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Standing.lean)
- **Counterexample:** World.dependingQueue and World.dependingRing: one condition stands at one and is active throughout, and members of a queue, or places of a ring, depend on it while in it, each needing a unit of it, every dependence met, with nothing flowing; such worlds meet all eight premises and count every tally, so the premises add nothing to the counts of dependence: they bear on dependence only together with activity, standing and descent. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Standing.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. · Properties of counts respect values step by step (pointwise), in place of function extensionality. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The laws of counting activity (whole-law-of-counting, counting-under-enclosure) read what is active; this result reads what stands and what depends in the same unfolding. Where nothing is enclosed what stands and what is active obey the same laws of counting: embodiment makes them one, and without it both are bound by the tally alone. Under enclosure they part: what the flow takes and gives is standing, so balance and dissipation alone bound the change of what stands, and what embodiment does is carry that bound from what stands to what is active. The counts of dependence are not bound by the premises, since the premises bear on dependence only together with activity, standing and descent: activity needing support asks only that what an active relatum depends on supports it, and bounded transmission only that what a descendant depends on as it comes to stand its parent depended on, within a bound. The author's reading (AI argument): what an enclosed unfolding spends is what stands, activity being bound with it only where embodied; this completes the statement of Part I's laws of counting, with no axiom, in the three readings, where binding (each selected premise binding) is stated for activity only. It does not evaluate coming to stand, ceasing to stand, forming or dissolving.

### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [whole-law-of-counting](whole-law-of-counting.md). Reuses tallies and queues (Tally, Listed.tally, Queue.holds, Queue.line, Queue.listed, Queue.counts), Pointwise, World.CountsObey, World.counting_under and World.counting_binds_iff, and the open and driven queues (World.openQueue_census, World.openQueue_counts, World.drivenQueue_holds, OpenQueue.driven).
  - Output: Under each selection the laws of counting activity are the tally, and where it binds counting, nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active.
  - Input: With embodiment what stands is what is active, so the laws of counting what stands are the same; without it a queue fed from a source counts every tally.
  - Preserved conditions: Listing; decidability; pointwise. [Counting.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Counting.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [counting-under-enclosure](counting-under-enclosure.md). Reuses the laws under each selection with enclosure and in finite worlds (World.enclosed_counting_under, World.enclosed_change_bound_iff, World.finite_counting_under), the closing queue (EnclosedQueue.closing, World.closingQueue_balanced, World.closingQueue_enclosed, World.closingQueue_dissipative), rings (Ring.census, Ring.counts, World.embodiedRing_meets) and the finite queue (World.finiteQueue_premised, World.finiteQueue_census, World.finiteQueue_counts).
  - Output: The laws of counting activity under each selection with enclosure and in finite worlds; a change bound where balance, embodiment and dissipation are selected.
  - Input: The laws of what stands add the change bound where balance and dissipation are selected, with no embodiment.
  - Preserved conditions: Listing; decidability; pointwise; enclosure or finiteness. [Counting.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Counting.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [continued-change-needs-openness](continued-change-needs-openness.md). Reuses the census of what stands (Web.StandingCensus, World.standingCensus), that across an enclosed step the total standing never rises and every change of standing lowers it (Flow.standing_never_rises, Flow.change_lowers), and that an enclosed step is not refutably enclosed around what stands (Flow.Enclosed.aroundStanding_not_not).
  - Output: Under balance and dissipation, across a step enclosed around what stands, the total standing never rises and every change of standing lowers it.
  - Input: Under enclosure the change of what stands stays within the total standing, with no premise on activity.
  - Preserved conditions: A census of what stands; balance; dissipation; enclosure. [Openness.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Openness.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [map-of-premises](map-of-premises.md). Reuses the eight premises and their selections (World.Premised.of, World.Premised.meets, World.Meets), that the four premises about the flow hold vacuously where nothing flows (World.still_vacuous), and that every step of a finite world is enclosed (World.Finite.enclosed).
  - Output: The eight premises and their selections; every step of a finite world enclosed.
  - Input: The depending queue and ring meet all eight premises.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Premises.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Premises.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [laws-of-one-step](laws-of-one-step.md). The proofs now go through the laws of one step: bound and binding of what stands under enclosure (World.enclosure_bounds_standing, World.enclosed_binds_standing).
  - Output: Across steps that run down the change of what stands stays within the total standing at the first, with no embodiment.
  - Input: Across enclosed steps the premises give the running down.
  - Preserved conditions: Balance; dissipation; enclosure. [Locality.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Locality.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [theory-of-becoming-foundation](theory-of-becoming-foundation.md). Plan P47: the two other readings of Part I's laws of counting; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.
